action_instruction: Checking whether the checkout control is visible and enabled
intent: whether the checkout control is visible and enabled

action_params.condition: the checkout page exposes a visible enabled checkout control
action_params.query: whether the checkout control is visible and enabled
action_params.code_js: (() => { const b = el(34); return !!(b && !b.disabled && b.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true' && (b.offsetWidth || b.offsetHeight || b.getClientRects().length)); })()

action_instruction: Checking whether the checkout control is ready for the customer to use
intent: whether the checkout control is ready for the customer to use

action_params.condition: the checkout control is ready for the customer to use
action_params.query: whether the checkout control is ready for the customer to use
action_params.code_js: (() => { const b = el(34); const text = (b?.innerText || '').trim(); return !!(b && !b.disabled && b.getAttribute('aria-disabled') !== 'true' && (b.offsetWidth || b.offsetHeight || b.getClientRects().length) && /^Pay\s+\$\d/.test(text)); })()

assertion_tree.description: the checkout page exposes a visible enabled checkout control that is ready for the customer to use

sub_results.description: the checkout page exposes a visible enabled checkout control
the checkout control is ready for the customer to use

assertion_tree.verification: Look for a checkout control on the checkout page that is visible, enabled, and ready for the customer to use
